title: Customized Ybor City Private Brewery Tour by Golf Cart
blurb: By booking a Zip Ride Brewery Tour, up to five guests are provided pickup, drop off and transportation between up to five Breweries. There are five Breweries in Ybor pre-selected, but riders have the option to modify their trip from a full list of location. All riders must be 21 years of age or older. This tour lasts 2.5 hours including pick up and drop off. This tour provides the transportation in a fun and unique way to see the City of Tampa and visit your choice of breweries.
